model_meta.description: Concept-level structural and behavioral model of an engine-mounted assembly combining a spring-biased belt tensioning pulley and a coaxial idler pulley.

subsystems.subsystem_name: Fixed Pivot Structure and Mounting Bolt
subsystems.description: Fixed pivot structure comprises a hollow cylindrical shaft whose axial bore receives the mounting bolt, and a distinct base/spindle structure secured to the shaft; its annular portion mounts against the engine surface. Together they establish the arm pivot and coaxial pulley axis.
Arm with hub journaled on the fixed pivot structure by pivot bushings; extends radially to carry the tensioning pulley and moves about the pivot axis.

parts.description: Integral pulley mounting portion with axial bore and ball-bearing support for the tensioning pulley, as disclosed in the illustrated embodiment.
Thrust washer positioned between the arm and retaining member in the illustrated embodiment.

subsystems.description: Helical coil torsion spring coupled between the fixed pivot structure and arm, surrounding the pivot and biasing the arm toward belt engagement; axially compressed in the claimed arrangement.
Member fixed to the pivot structure between the idler pulley and arm; retains axial spring force and arm and provides a mounting surface for the idler pulley.
Rotatably mounted at the distal arm position and engages the belt; spring bias urges the pulley into tensioning engagement.
Rotates about the mounting-bolt axis on the retaining-member mounting surface, supported by a ball-bearing assembly, and has a belt-engaging peripheral surface.
Optional damping sleeve is mounted on the arm hub. A surrounding ring abuts the spring volute and transmits inward force to the sleeve; sleeve friction against the hub damps arm movement.

parts.description: Force-transmitting ring surrounding the sleeve and abutting a spring volute.

subsystems.description: External mounting structure receiving the mounting bolt and supporting the fixed pivot assembly.
External belt trained around the tensioning pulley and idler pulley as part of the vehicle belt-drive system.

item_flows.name: Spring biasing torque
item_flows.notes: Torsion spring biases the arm in the belt-tightening direction.

item_flows.name: Axial spring load
item_flows.notes: Spring axial compression applies axial force on the arm; retaining member retains the force.

item_flows.name: Belt contact and load
item_flows.notes: Mechanical contact/load interaction between the belt and the tensioning and idler pulleys; during operation belt load can rotate the arm opposite the spring bias.

item_flows.name: Engine mounting load
item_flows.notes: Mounting bolt fixes pivot structure to engine block.

steps.description: During engine operation, when the belt slackens, the spring rotates the arm toward belt engagement.
The arm moves the tensioning pulley toward the belt to take up slack.
When the belt is tensioned, belt load can rotate the arm oppositely against spring force.
The compressed spring applies axial force to the arm.
The retaining member fixed to the pivot structure retains the axial force and axially retains the arm.

requirements.statement: Provide an engine-mounted fixed pivot structure, coaxial idler, pivoting arm carrying a spaced tensioning pulley, spring bias toward belt engagement, and retaining member that axially retains the arm and provides an idler mounting surface.
requirements.rationale: Traceability to independent claim 1; claim 8 further specifies axial spring compression and retention.

requirements.statement: In the claim-8 combination, the compressed torsion spring applies axial force on the arm and the retaining member retains that force.
requirements.rationale: Independent claim 8 distinguishes this axial compression/retention relationship from claim 1.
